column1: Recent indicators suggest that growth of economic activity has slowed from its strong
pace in the third quarter.  Job gains have moderated since earlier in the year but remain strong,
and the unemployment rate has remained low.  Inflation has eased over the past year but remains elevated .
The U.S. banking system is sound and resilient.  Tighter financial and credit conditions
for households and businesses are likely to weigh on economic activity, hiring, and inflation.  The extent of these effects remains uncertain.
